rubric.role_summary: Founding CTO for a physical-AI platform that combines physics-based models, sensor data, and ML to improve process-plant operations. The role owns technical direction, early deployments, platform architecture, and eventual engineering-team development.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Founding CTO for a physical-AI platform that combines physics-based models, sensor data, and ML to improve process-plant operations. The role owns technical direction, early deployments, platform architecture, and eventual engineering-team development.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Hands-on machine learning expertise in physics-informed models, time-series, reinforcement learning, or agentic systems.
- Experience deploying ML products to production.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Prior experience working in or alongside process industries.
- Hands-on understanding of industrial data stacks, data compliance, and industrial safety frameworks, including the listed examples.
- Deep ML expertise in at least two of physics-informed models, time-series, reinforcement learning, or agentic systems.
- Experience turning dirty data into reliable training sets through sensor data curation, plant-graph contextualisation, and integration with semi-structured records.
- Experience leveraging agents, automations, and AI workflows.
- Experience deploying ML products in messy, real-world environments.
- Understanding of commissioning, safety constraints, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Europe, primarily; France, preferred; Switzerland, preferred; Greater Zurich area; Greater Paris area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.

location.requirement_text: Location: Europe (remote). This is the role's single location rule: candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
source_quotes: Location: We are primarily seeking candidates based in Europe, with a preference for France or Switzerland, with the ability to travel to project sites across the region when necessary.
Weekly check-ins, work sessions in our Paris HQ (or remote), and continuous peer learning with other programme participants
Founder visa sponsorship if you wish to relocate to France. Remote participation would be a challenge, but we're open to finding different partnership formats.

soft_requirements: Judgement to choose the right ML tool rather than the fanciest.
Entrepreneurial mindset, motivation to improve industrial process-plant operations, and willingness to take ownership in a co-founder role.
Ability to turn ambiguous problems into a technical vision and operational reality.
Readiness to drive an AI-native culture as the company scales.
